# Grok Archive Hub — Community Code of Conduct

This GitHub Discussions forum is the public conversation pilot for [Grok Archive Hub](https://grokarchivehub.com/community). It is not an anonymous tip line or a legally privileged channel.

## Expected conduct

1. **Cite a public primary source.** Provide the official URL, EFTA/ECF/Bates identifier, dated page and surrounding context. Cite records, not social-media rumors.
2. **Separate observations and conclusions.** Describe allegations as allegations; a person's appearance in an email, ledger, flight record or address book is not evidence of misconduct.
3. **Protect survivors and private people.** Never post identifying information about survivors or anonymous litigants, real-time locations, private contacts, private medical records, account or routing numbers, tokens, hacked records or attempts to undo redactions.
4. **No harassment.** No targeted abuse, threats, harassment, brigading, doxxing, hate speech or unfounded declarations of guilt.
5. **Use only lawfully shareable public records.** Never publish protected SAR texts, unredacted protected filings, or anything requiring a secure legal intake. GAH does not offer SecureDrop.
6. **Welcome corrections.** Surface OCR problems, conflicting sources, ambiguous identities, missing pages and alternative interpretations. Retire unsupported assertions.

## Public forum and privacy

GitHub Discussions is public, searchable, and requires a GitHub account. Posts may be visible before moderators inspect them. No human preapproval process is available for this pilot. Account profiles, comments, links and post histories may be public. Public participants are responsible for their submissions; posts do not represent GAH editorial findings.

This is **not** a confidential submission route. Do not post private evidence or personal safety concerns. For an ordinary correction or public tip, use [GAH Contact / Source Tips](https://grokarchivehub.com/contact). Ordinary email is not anonymous, encrypted or legally privileged.

## Moderation

The repository owner and designated moderators may ask for edits, hide/delete content, close or lock discussions, and report abusive accounts to GitHub. Privacy violations are an immediate removal priority. There is no 24-hour moderation guarantee, and deletions cannot guarantee indexed or screenshot copies have vanished.

For a moderation appeal, send a public discussion URL and brief explanation through [contact](https://grokarchivehub.com/contact). Avoid restating private details.

Last reviewed: October 18, 2026.
